title: 正弦稳态的叠加定理：相量相加
statement: ω = 1000 rad/s，U̇_s = 10∠0° V，İ_s = 2.5∠90° A（同频率，有效值相量），R = 4 Ω，C = 250 µF，L = 5 mH（与电流源串联）。
用叠加定理求结点电压 U_a，再求电流源上端结点 c 的电压 U_c。

questions.explain: U_s 单独作用：U̇_a′ = 5 − j5 V；I_s 单独作用：U̇_a″ = 5 + j5 V。U_a = U_a′ + U_a″ = 10 V。
电流 I_s 从 c 经 L 流向 a：U̇_c = U̇_a + jX_L·İ_s = 10 + j5 × j2.5 = 10 − 12.5 = −2.5 V。L 不影响 U_a，但影响电流源两端的电压。

questions.ask: 两个分量的模都是 7.07 V，为什么 |U_a| 不是 14.14 V？
choices: 叠加的是相量：两个分量相位差 90°，要按复数相加
叠加定理在正弦稳态电路中不成立
因为电感 L 消耗了一部分电压
choiceExplain: 叠加定理适用于任何线性电路，包括正弦稳态（用相量）；问题出在把两个分量的模直接相加。
L 与电流源串联，不影响电流源送出的电流，对 U_a 没有作用；|U_a| 小于 14.14 V 是因为两个分量相差 90°。
questions.explain: 同频率的正弦量可以用相量叠加：U̇_a = 7.07∠−45° + 7.07∠45° = 10∠0° V。有效值（模）一般不能直接相加；频率不同的分量则只能在时域相加。

hints: U_s 单独作用时 I_s 开路：R 与 C 分压。I_s 单独作用时 U_s 短路：I_s 流入 R ∥ C。
与电流源串联的 L 对结点 a 以左的电路没有影响（电流源支路的电流总是 I_s）。
solution: **1. 复阻抗。** Z_C = −j/(ωC) = −j4 Ω，Z_L = jωL = j5 Ω。
**5. 结点 c。** L 中的电流就是 I_s（从 c 流向 a），U̇_c = U̇_a + Z_L·İ_s = 10 + j5 × j2.5 = **−2.5 V**。
注意：L 串联在电流源支路里，对 U_a 没有任何影响，但电流源两端电压 U_c 与 L 有关。

en.title: Superposition in sinusoidal steady state: phasors add
tags: element in series with a current source
statement: ω = 1000 rad/s, U̇_s = 10∠0° V, İ_s = 2.5∠90° A (same frequency, rms phasors), R = 4 Ω, C = 250 µF, L = 5 mH (in series with the current source).
Use superposition to find the node voltage U_a, then find the voltage U_c of node c at the top of the current source.

questions.explain: U_s alone: U̇_a′ = 5 − j5 V; I_s alone: U̇_a″ = 5 + j5 V. U_a = U_a′ + U_a″ = 10 V.
The imaginary parts of 7.07∠−45° and 7.07∠45° cancel: U̇_a = 10∠0° V.
I_s flows from c through L to a: U̇_c = U̇_a + jX_L·İ_s = 10 + j5 × j2.5 = 10 − 12.5 = −2.5 V. L does not affect U_a, but it does affect the voltage across the current source.

questions.ask: Both components have magnitude 7.07 V. Why is |U_a| not 14.14 V?
choices: Superposition adds phasors: the two components are 90° apart and must be added as complex numbers
Superposition does not hold in sinusoidal steady state
Because the inductor L uses up part of the voltage
choiceExplain: Superposition holds in any linear circuit, including sinusoidal steady state (with phasors); the mistake is adding the two magnitudes directly.
L is in series with the current source and does not change the current it delivers, so it has no effect on U_a; |U_a| < 14.14 V because the components are 90° apart.
questions.explain: Sinusoids of the same frequency superpose as phasors: U̇_a = 7.07∠−45° + 7.07∠45° = 10∠0° V. Magnitudes (rms values) generally do not add; components of different frequencies can only be added in the time domain.

hints: U_s alone: I_s open, R and C form a divider. I_s alone: U_s shorted, I_s flows into R ∥ C.
The L in series with the current source has no effect on the circuit left of node a (the branch current is always I_s).
solution: **1. Impedances.** Z_C = −j/(ωC) = −j4 Ω, Z_L = jωL = j5 Ω.
**5. Node c.** The current in L is I_s (from c to a), U̇_c = U̇_a + Z_L·İ_s = 10 + j5 × j2.5 = **−2.5 V**.
Note: L in series with the current source has no effect on U_a, but the voltage U_c across the current source does depend on L.
